translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
aik maangney walay ney woh azab maanga hai
jo kafiron per aaney wala hai ,   koi nahi hai jo ussay rok sakay .
woh Allah ki taraf say aaye ga jo charrney kay tamam raaston ka malik hai ,
farishtay aur rooh-ul-qudus uss ki taraf aik aesay din mein charh ker jatay hain jiss ki miqdaar pachas hazar saal hai .
lehaza tum khoobsurti kay sath sabar say kaam lo .
yeh log ussay door samajh rahey hain ,
aur hum ussay qareeb dekh rahey hain .
. ( woh azab ) uss din hoga jab aasman tel ki talchat ki tarah hojaye ga ,
aur pahar rangeen rooi ki tarah hojayen gay ,
aur koi jigri dost kissi jigri dost ko poochay ga bhi nahi ,
halankay woh aik doosray ko dikha bhi diye jayen gay . mujrim yeh chahye ga kay uss din kay azab say choottney kay liye apney betay fidya mein deydey ,
aur apni biwi aur apna bhai ,
aur apna woh khandan jo ussay panah deta tha ,
aur zameen kay saray kay saray bashinday . phir ( unn sabb ko fidya mein dey ker ) apney aap ko bacha ley .
. ( lekin ) aisa hergiz nahi hosakay ga ! woh to aik bharakti hoi aag hai ,
jo khaal utaar ley gi ,
her uss shaks ko bulaye gi jiss ney peeth pher ker mun morra hoga ,
aur ( maal ) ikattha kiya hoga , phir ussay seent seent ker rakha hoga .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay insan boht kam hosla peda kiya gaya hai ,
jab ussay koi takleef phonchti hai to boht woh ghabra jata hai ,
aur jab uss kay paas khushhali aati hai to boht bakheel ban jata hai ,
magar woh namazi aesay nahi hain ,
jo apni namaz ki hamesha pabandi kertay hain ,
aur jinn kay maal o dolat mein aik mutayyan haq hai
sawali aur bey sawali ka
aur jo roz jaza ko bar-haq mantay hain ,
aur jo apney perwerdigar kay azab say sehmay rehtay hain ,
. yaqeenan unn kay perwerdigar ka azab aesi cheez nahi hai jiss say bey fikri barti jaye
aur jo apni sharmgahon ki ( aur sabb say ) hifazat kertay hain ,
. siwaye apni biwiyon aur unn baandiyon kay jo unn ki milkiyat mein aa-chuki hon , kiyonkay aesay logon  per koi malamat nahi hai .
albatta jo log inn kay ilawa koi aur tareeqa ikhtiyar kerna chahen , woh hadd say guzray huye log hain
aur jo apni amanton aur ehad ka paas rakhney walay hain ,
aur jo apni gawahiyon theek theek denay walay hain ,
aur jo apni namaz ki poori poori hifazat kernay walay hain ,
woh log hain jo jannaton mein izzat kay sath rahen gay .
tu ( aey payghumber ! ) inn kafiron ko kiya hogaya kay yeh tumhari taraf charrhay chalay aarahey hain ,
dayen taraf say bhi aur bayen taraf say bhi , toliyan bana bana ker !
kiya inn mein say her shaks ko yeh lalach hai kay ussay naimaton wali jannat mein dakhil kiya jaye ?
hergiz aisa nahi hoga ! hum ney unn ko uss cheez say peda kiya hai jissay yeh khud jantay hain .
abb mein qasam khata hun unn tamam maqamaat kay malik ki jahan say sitaray nikaltay aur jahan say ghuroob hotay hain kay hum yaqeenan iss baat per qadir hain
kay unn ki jagah unn say behtar log ley ayen ,   aur koi hamen hara nahi sakta .
lehaza tum enhen chorr do kay yeh apni beyhooda baaton mein munhamik aur khel kood mein parr rahen , yahan tak kay apney uss din say jaa milen jiss ka inn say wada kiya jaraha hai .
jiss din yeh jaldi jaldi qabron say iss tarah niklen gay jaisay apney button ki taraf dorray jarahey hon .
inn ki nigahen jhuki hoi hon gi , zillat inn per chai hoi hogi . yeh wohi din hoga jiss ka inn say wada kiya jaraha hai .
